title: Sonnet 5's Price Hike Is Cancelled
caption:
Last week I told you to budget +50% for Sonnet 5. That's cancelled.

Aug 10: Anthropic made the $2/$10 intro price permanent. The Sept 1 jump to $3/$15 will not happen.

The part nobody mentions — 4.7 and later count tokens with a newer tokenizer, roughly 30% more for the same text. So the sticker cut is bigger than the bill cut.

What's your monthly API spend?

slides.sub: The +50% that was scheduled for September 1 will not happen. Announced August 10.

slides.title: $2 in, $10 out
slides.sub: Launched as introductory pricing through Aug 31. It is now the standard price per million tokens.

slides.title: Read the fine print
items: Sonnet 4.6 bills $3/$15 per MTok. Sonnet 5 is a third cheaper on both, permanently.
Batch API halves it again: $1 in, $5 out. Cache hits land at $0.20 per MTok.
But Sonnet 5 uses the 4.7-and-later tokenizer, roughly 30% more tokens for the same text. Sonnet 4.6 did not.
